reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by calling the existing shared getScheduledAmount, the same helper the posting and preview paths use.

duplication.why: No amount logic is duplicated; the rule stays in the one helper.

placement.why: The field is produced in the scheduleModel.toExternal mapper, the right layer, but it is added to APIScheduleEntity, the type also used as input for create and update.

scope.why: Besides the feature, it renames the helper's unused rounding parameter to _rounding, reflows an expression and reorders a test import, none of which the request needed.

maintainability.why: Making an output-only field part of the shared input/output entity forces Omit<..., 'expectedAmount'> and a dummy expectedAmount: 0 in schedule-create, and leaves it accepted by the Partial<APIScheduleEntity> update path; a separate list type would be cleaner.
